logline: 화가 배질이 그린 초상 앞에서 도리언은 그림이 대신 늙기를 빌고, 여배우 시빌을 버린 밤 초상의 입가에 주름이 잡히자 장막을 씌워 다락에 감춘 채 열여덟 해를 젊게 살다가, 소문을 물으러 온 배질에게 늙고 추악해진 초상을 보여 준다
destination: 소설 도리언 그레이의 초상에서 만날 수 있습니다
setting: 1890년대 런던 — 화가의 화실과 정원, 도리언의 저택 서재와 아침 식당, 작은 극장의 무대와 분장실, 안개 낀 밤거리의 클럽 계단, 저택 꼭대기의 다락
anchor: a slender fair-haired young man of twenty in a dark blue frock coat before a life-size portrait of himself in a gilt frame
palette: dark green, dark blue, ash grey, off-white, dull yellow
withheld: 칼이 어디에 꽂혔는지와, 반지가 가리킨 사람

beats.beat: 화가 배질이 도리언의 초상을 마지막으로 손본다

beats.beat: 도리언이 완성된 초상 앞에서 그림이 대신 늙었으면 하고 빈다

beats.beat: 도리언이 무대 위 여배우 시빌 베인에게 마음을 빼앗긴다
beats.visual: the dull yellow glare of the gas footlights in the small shabby theatre, seen from the plush box at the side: the slight girl of seventeen with the dark brown hair in one long plait and the small pale oval face, in Juliet's off-white gown with the long hanging sleeves and the dull yellow girdle, is the one standing at frame centre on the painted stone balcony of the stage with both her thin arms stretched out over its edge and her big dark eyes lifted, her lips parted in the middle of a line; the row of tin-shaded footlights runs along the bottom of the stage; at the near right edge of the frame the gilt rail of the box and the shoulder of the slender young man of twenty with the thick fair golden-brown curls in the dark blue frock coat show close and large, seen from behind, his face turned to the stage and hidden; the girl on the stage is the only figure with her face to the camera

beats.beat: 시빌이 분장실에서 사랑에 빠진 뒤로 연기가 가짜처럼 느껴졌다고 말한다
beats.visual: the dull yellow light of the ring of gas jets round the mirror in the small cramped dressing room: the slight girl of seventeen, still in Juliet's off-white gown with the dull yellow girdle, is the one standing at frame left with both her thin hands pressed together against her breast and her big dark eyes lifted, shining, to the young man's face, her lips parted as she speaks; the slender young man of twenty with the thick fair golden-brown curls and the smooth pale face, in the dark blue frock coat, is the one standing stiff at frame right by the narrow open door with both hands at his sides and his face turned to her, his full lips pressed thin and his clear blue eyes cold; the table of paint pots stands under the mirror between them and the mirror gives back only the grey wall; there are exactly two people in the room
beats.motion: the girl's pressed hands and lifted face are the one thing that moves, and the young man holds still: at the start both her thin hands are pressed together against her breast with her big dark eyes lifted to his face; over the first three seconds the pressed hands rise slowly until they are held under her chin and her small face lifts higher with a slow smile spreading and her lips moving as she speaks, the long plait shifting a little on her shoulder; in the last two seconds the hands hold under her chin and the smile stays; her feet do not shift; the young man by the open door keeps his hands at his sides and his face turned to her with his lips pressed thin and his eyes cold, nothing in him moving; the mirror keeps its steady gas jets without flicker and the paint pots on the table keep their places; the hung costumes, the empty chair and the dim passage beyond the door hold completely still; no new figures or objects appear; the framing does not change at all; camera locked off, no tracking, no zoom, no drift

beats.beat: 형편없는 연기를 본 도리언이 매정하게 등을 돌리고 나간다
beats.visual: the dull yellow light of the one gas jet in its wire cage on the brick wall of the narrow bare passage behind the stage: the slender young man of twenty with the thick fair golden-brown curls, in the dark blue frock coat, is the one walking away from the camera down the middle of the passage at frame centre, seen entirely from behind so that only the back of his fair curly head, the back of his dark blue coat and the heels of his shoes show, not one part of his face visible, his back straight and both hands at his sides, the far door ahead of him; the plain door at the far end of the passage is the one small dark shape ahead of him; the slight girl of seventeen with the dark brown hair in one long plait, in Juliet's off-white gown, is the one standing at the near left edge of the frame in the open doorway of the dressing room with one thin hand holding the door frame and her small pale face turned after him, her big dark eyes wide and her lips parted; there are exactly two people in the passage

beats.beat: 집에 돌아온 도리언이 초상의 입가에서 낯선 주름을 본다
beats.visual: the cold ash grey light of dawn through the tall windows of the panelled library, close on the picture: the picture inside its wide carved gilt frame fills the upper half of the frame above the white marble fireplace at frame centre, the painted figure of the slender fair-haired young man in the dark blue frock coat standing against his flat dark green ground, the painted face smooth and pale, and at one corner of the painted mouth a single faint hard line drawn down that pulls the full lips into the beginning of a sneer; the slender young man of twenty, in the dark blue frock coat with the dark green silk tie pulled loose, is the one standing at frame right close under the picture with his face lifted to that painted mouth and his own full lips parted, one hand gripping the edge of the marble mantel and the other lifted half way toward the picture with the fingers spread; there is exactly one living man in the room and one painted figure

beats.beat: 이튿날 찾아온 헨리 경이 도리언에게 시빌의 죽음을 전한다

beats.beat: 도리언이 초상에 장막을 씌워 다락에 올리고 문을 잠근다
beats.visual: thin grey daylight from the one small square window of the long bare attic room with the sloping ceiling and the dark brown beams: the picture inside its wide carved gilt frame is the one thing standing upright on the dusty floorboards at frame centre against the wall, and the large heavy cloth of dark green brocade with its dull gold pattern is drawn down over it from the top so that it covers the painted face and the upper half of the frame; the slender young man of twenty with the thick fair golden-brown curls, in the dark blue frock coat, is the one standing at frame right beside the picture with both hands raised holding the lower edge of the cloth, drawing it down, his smooth pale face turned away from the picture toward the door with his lips set; the plain wooden door with its iron lock is closed at the far right with an iron key standing in the lock; there is exactly one man in the room

beats.beat: 열여덟 해가 흘러도 도리언은 그대로이고 소문만 나빠진다
beats.visual: the dull yellow light of the two gas lamps in their iron brackets either side of the tall door of the club on the foggy street at night: the slender young man of twenty, in the black evening tailcoat with the white waistcoat and white tie, is the one standing still at the top of the stone steps at frame centre under the pillared porch with one bare hand resting on the iron railing and the other hanging at his side, his face turned a little to the left with his full lips in a faint smile; two stout elderly gentlemen in black overcoats and top hats with grey side whiskers are the ones at the bottom of the steps at frame left, seen from behind, both turned away from him toward the street with their backs squared; the wet pavement gives back the dull yellow lamplight in long smears; the young man's face is the only face in the picture and it is smooth and young

beats.beat: 어느 밤 배질이 찾아와 도리언에게 소문을 묻는다

beats.beat: 도리언이 다락의 장막을 걷어 늙고 추악해진 초상을 배질에게 보여 준다

beats.beat: 배질이 기도하라고 외치고, 도리언이 등불을 놓고 그 앞에 선다

beats.beat: 잠긴 다락 문 아래로 등불 빛이 한 줄 새어 나온다
